page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. It carries the e-rara.ch logo, a banner, multilingual terms of use, a Visual Library logo and persistent link, all left out. Its catalogue data, which is not the book's own text, reads: title "Dialogi ab Eusebio Philadelpho cosmopolita in Gallorum et caeterarum nationum gratiam compositi quorum primus ad ipso auctore recognitus et auctus : alter vero in lucem nunc primum editus fuit."; author "Eusebius Philadelphus [Barnaud, Nicolas?]"; imprint "Edimbourg [Lausanne], 1574"; holder "Bibliothèque de Genève", shelf mark Su 2431.
